serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: A new restaurant opened nearby. I was thinking that we could go there and check it out.
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: So…{{wi}} It’s a date, right?
You: Y-yeah
#bot.Expression.NoHappy
Bot: What do you know about it?
You: Not much, I just saw their ad on some website. I wonder how did they know that I live nearby though.
Bot: You have enabled geolocation on your phone. That restaurant probably runs targeted ads.
I kinda feel like my privacy has been invaded…
Although thanks to that ad, I had a pretext to go out with {f_botName} again, so maybe it’s not all bad.
